name: Sajjangad Fort
description: Hill fort with the samadhi of Samarth Ramdas Swami, reached by steps or a short drive, with wide valley views.

name: Ajinkyatara Fort
description: Fort overlooking Satara city, a good short climb with a city and hills view.

name: Kaas Plateau
description: High plateau known for seasonal wildflowers. Check that the flowering season and any entry rules fit your visit.

name: Thoseghar Waterfalls
description: Cascading falls best seen after the monsoon, with viewpoints near the road.

name: Krishna River at Mahuli
description: Riverside temples at the confluence, a calm place for a slow evening walk.

name: Chalkewadi Windmills
description: Open plateau with rows of wind turbines, popular for the breeze and sunset views.
